name: 板板壳
evolution: 板板壳 → 咔咔壳 Lv.16 → 水泡壳 Lv.36
description: 平时看似懒懒的，感到危险时，柔软的身体会迅速缩回壳里。柔韧的尾巴看起来像海草，偶尔会被饥饿的水生精灵咬一口。
descriptionEn: It looks lazy most of the time, but when it senses danger, its soft body quickly withdraws into its shell. Its flexible tail looks like seaweed and is occasionally bitten by hungry aquatic creatures.
